reply.description:
Implementation plan for DCR 01a0dbf43851 (W1). Order 3 of 9; the first item on the critical path (W1 → C1 → B1 → P1 → V1). Filing is not authorization.

GOALS
- A documented, reusable record template for objective/task and dispatch-attempt, built on EXISTING item types and fields wherever they fit: parent/review/retry references, goal and non-goals, role/actor, input head revision, required integration branches, evidence, result, deferred-validation state. Task outcome is recorded separately from attempt state and from review/test/push/release facts — no single linear status field carries everything.
- One conditional-mutation primitive (if_revision) so a stale update is refused. Data revisions (lost-update prevention) and ownership claims (who may mutate protected fields) are distinct concepts that may share the primitive.
- Claim, release and reassign on a defined set of protected work fields; reassignment invalidates the previous holder's claim; a human override is possible and audited.
- Scoped standing authorization recorded with provenance, independent of assignment, so a human is not re-prompted where authority already exists. Reading a record never claims it, accepts a finding, or authorizes execution.
- Concise saved queries (unowned, blocked, awaiting review, authorized-for) and a GUI that shows claim holder and authorization from the same state.

NON-GOALS (from the DCR)
- A mandatory process, provider hierarchy, scheduler or learned model selection.
- Claim tokens that claim to stop external processes or undo side effects; exactly-once execution from record ownership.
- A second task database or new schema where existing fields/templates suffice.

TASK ORDER AND WHY
  T0  record template + trust model, on paper       consumers (C1, P1, V1) code against this; it must be reviewed before any of them start
  T1  if_revision conditional update                the shared primitive; one implementation with D1
  T2  claims on protected fields + audited override the handover mechanism; needs T1 for stale-refusal
  T3  standing authorization records                independent of T2; needs T0's field names
  T4  saved queries + GUI inspection                needs T2 and T3

Hard dependencies: T0 → {T1, T3}; T1 → T2; {T2, T3} → T4.

CROSS-DCR
- C1 T3 (scoped container Docket access) and B1 T3 (handover) consume T2's claim semantics. P1 T0 maps the task-cycle skill onto T0's template. V1 T0 reads T0's template.
- T1 is shared with D1 T1: whichever lands first owns it.
- Caller identity for claims comes from the MCP/gateway caller, reconciled with C1 T1 grants; this plan records the trust model, it does not build the gateway.

WHAT THIS PLAN DOES NOT CLAIM
It does not deliver a scheduler, dispatch UI, or any process; it delivers records that a process (P1) can fill and a viewer (V1) can read.

reply.description:
GOAL
A Docket KB article (project docket) that is the contract every consumer codes against: which item types represent objective/task and dispatch attempt; which existing fields carry role/actor, input head revision, required integration branches, evidence, result and deferred-validation state; how outcome, attempt state and review/test/push/release facts are kept apart; which fields are PROTECTED (claim-gated); and who the caller is for a claim (MCP caller identity, gateway-stamped identity for containers, human in the GUI).

DONE WHEN
- The KB article exists with a field-by-field table; every field is an existing Docket field or marked NEW with a one-line reason why nothing existing fits.
- One real, hand-filled task-cycle record (objective, one task, one dispatch attempt with evidence and result) exists in a Docket project and the article links it.
- The article states the shared-project trust model in one paragraph: what a stale holder can and cannot do, what a human override records.
- Codex has reviewed it and its findings are accepted or answered on the item.

TRAPS
- Do not invent a new schema where a template over work_item + tags + links suffices. The DCR's non-goal is explicit.

LINKS
Plan 01a0dc037e2d. Blocks T1, T3. Consumed by C1 T3, P1 T0, V1 T0.
